details: Visual inspection shows chapter 14 begins at printed p. 225 / PDF p. 237 and the requested respiratory content runs through printed p. 231 / PDF p. 243.

ASR forms such as 'splenic mesoderm,' chamber-name slips, and 'precardial' were normalized to splanchnic mesoderm, correct chamber direction, and pericardial terminology. The transcript is ambiguous around pulmonary-vein growth direction and suggests a neural-crest epicardial contribution not stated in the cited Langman passage; new items follow Langman's dorsal-mesenchymal-protrusion and proepicardial account.

The transcripts contain unreliable SVC/IVC and interrupted-arch phrases, including a mislabeled hepatic IVC contributor. New items use Langman's right vitelline hepatocardiac, right subcardinal, and right sacrocardinal IVC segments and Langman's illustrated interrupted-arch types.

Slides cite older Langman page numbers and E2 uses 'saccular phase'; questions cite the supplied 15th edition's printed/PDF pages and treat saccular as the slide term corresponding to the book's terminal-sac period. Slide typos were not copied into learner-facing text.

New stems were compared with existing term2-cvs, term2-cvs-gaps, term2-respiratory-embryology, term2-respiratory-embryology-gaps, term2-limbs, term2-limbs-gaps, and other embryology JSONL stems. They are original practice questions and are not labeled or represented as past questions. Independent source review remains pending.
